Team / Katie —

Quick hygiene note as we head into the final Q4 planning: we pulled a small SFDC export for the MedVantage opportunity (RDW-3241) and there are a few fields that need confirmation before finance finalizes the forecast. I attached a CSV and a short deal summary.

High level asks (should take <10 mins):
- Vanessa: please confirm the current Opportunity Stage in SFDC and update to one of our canonical stages (Commit / Best Case / Qualification).
- Vanessa: verify the Close Date provenance — if this is a negotiated delivery commitment, mark it as "Customer-backed" with supporting notes.

- Katie: can you confirm procurement timeline (week-of Dec 8 or earlier?) so we can lock the close window. If you prefer, reply with a short confirmation or forward the procurement contact.

If we don't get confirmation by EOD Friday (Nov 21) we'll move RDW-3241 to "At Risk" and reduce the commit by 50% for the Q4 forecast. Not ideal but necessary for forecast integrity.

Attachments: SFDC_stage_export_RDW-3241.csv, DealSummary_RDW-3241.pdf
